This fixture is a gzip-compressed, byte-for-byte copy of the Acre Villas context SVG from dataset `20260905_150413_hebden_bridge_streets_parks_water_boundary_clip` (street `0001`). It retains the actual embedded OpenStreetMap raster and both vector polylines. Map attribution remains in its metadata. `framing.json` records the source hash and the full dataset reference span used by the existing rear framing policy.

The production strokes have direct width attributes: white 12.00 and pink 8.00, identical points, and no classes, inline styles or inherited group styles. No prepared face artwork is bundled or regenerated; the portable export regression uses the existing synthetic prepared-face fixture. The real production face was separately exported and checked without rewriting it.
